description: October 3 birthday meaning: Libra decan 2, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an October 3 birthday falls in Libra, in the second decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Uranus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Libra is cardinal and air.

sections.heading: Personality of an October 3 birthday
paragraphs: Around the 3rd of October, Libra's second decan begins, and Uranus, ruler of Aquarius, enters as sub-ruler. That adds originality and a taste for ideas to the sign's charm. Three is the number of creativity and conversation. Together they suggest an inventive social spirit, the person who reorganises the dinner party seating to spark the most interesting debate.

By noon UTC on October 3, the Sun has normally reached roughly 10° of Libra. That places the date in the Libra decan that astrologers give to Uranus, the second of three. The middle stretch of Libra, roughly October 3 to October 13, takes Uranus as sub-ruler, the planet associated with Aquarius in modern astrology. This tends to turn the sign's interest in fairness towards society at large. Natives are often pictured as idealistic, progressive and drawn to groups, networks and causes. Their relationships may be unconventional, or built on friendship and shared values more than tradition. Uranus brings originality and also a cool, detached streak when emotions run high. Combining their sense of justice with personal warmth usually helps them persuade rather than simply be right.

sections.heading: Numerology of the October 3 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 3rd, you carry a birthday number of 3 in its simplest form. As a supporting number, the day of birth is read as a gift that shows in everyday style rather than in the larger direction of a life. The single-digit 3 is traditionally associated with expression: talking, writing, making things, finding the joke in a heavy afternoon. Its energy is light and spontaneous, often called youthful whatever the person's age. Numerologists tend to suggest that 3s benefit from finishing what they begin, because their ideas are worth more completed than merely sketched in a notebook.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same October 3 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 4 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 6 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: October 3 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: October birthdays fall in mid-autumn north of the equator, with turning leaves and earlier evenings, and in mid-spring in the southern hemisphere. Libra holds most of the month, with Scorpio arriving around October 23. In numerology October is month 10, which reduces to 1: a number of new starts and independence, carried here with a 0 that is often read as amplifying it. October 3 is the 276th day of the year (277th in a leap year). In most years Scorpio season is under way by October 24, 21 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for an October 3 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. October 3 is also the birthday of Zlatan Ibrahimović (1981), Sergei Yesenin (1895) and Louis Aragon (1897).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is October 3?
faq.answer: October 3 is Libra in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Libra, which tradition links with Uranus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on October 3?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On October 3 the Life Path is 11 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 4 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 6 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 3rd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on October 3?
faq.answer: By October 3 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on October 3?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with an October 3 birthday are Zlatan Ibrahimović (1981), Sergei Yesenin (1895) and Louis Aragon (1897). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
